title: Showing value beyond external confirmation

captions.physics: Openly sharing and explaining useful substance
captions.emotions: Relief through releasing a false foundation

meaning: Conscious freedom from attachments can inspire you when clear shared action brings relief through releasing a false foundation.
text: The Devil in the energy of Sahasrara supports a wish to recognise attachments and recover conscious freedom of choice. The Sun in the physical position appears through jointly showing useful substance openly and explaining it clearly. The Tower in emotions brings relief as a false foundation falls away and a genuine basis becomes visible. Showing value through people’s actual possibilities may feel close to you both, freeing an endeavour from needing an impressive appearance to confirm your importance. A useful contribution can extend beyond your relationship when people encounter its content rather than only signs of prestige surrounding it.

For example, you jointly hold an open gathering about a small cultural space. Instead of listing prestigious guests, you show available sessions, actual results and ways to participate. **A clear contribution can free value from external confirmation.** A new visitor finds a suitable opportunity and offers a subject. You feel lighter without proving usefulness through famous names, as content gains an understandable life among people who genuinely need it.

Difficulty arises if the whole account proves the former splendour unnecessary while actual opportunities again escape attention. A freeing motive and relief through truthful foundations remain supportive. Shared action benefits from clearly showing content so someone understands what can be encountered and how it relates to their own interest.
